definitions.explanation: Speaking very quietly so that others cannot hear; whispering secretly.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}はひそひそと{話|はな}していた。
examples.english: The two were whispering to each other.

examples.japanese: {隣|となり}の{席|せき}でひそひそ{話|ばなし}が{聞|き}こえる。
examples.english: I can hear whispered conversation from the next seat.
examples.notes: ひそひそ話 is a common compound

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はひそひそ{声|ごえ}で{秘密|ひみつ}を{教|おし}えてくれた。
examples.english: He told me the secret in a whisper.

examples.japanese: {後|うし}ろでひそひそと{何|なに}か{言|い}っているのが{気|き}になる。
examples.english: It bothers me that they're whispering something behind me.

notes:
SOUND SYMBOLISM: The voiceless ひ sounds evoke the quiet, hushed quality of whispering.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・ひそひそ{話|ばなし} (whispered conversation, gossip)
・ひそひそ{声|ごえ} (whispered voice)

NUANCE: Often implies secrecy or gossip. Can have negative connotations when describing people whispering about others.

VERB FORMS:
・ひそひそ{話|はな}す (to whisper)
・ひそひそ{言|い}う (to say in a whisper)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・こそこそ: Stealthily, sneakily (about actions, not just speech)
・ぼそぼそ: Muttering (unclear speech, not necessarily quiet)
・がやがや: Noisily, clamorously (antonym)
